rules.note: Full-frame L-mount S series (DC-S1/S5/S9 and Mark II/IIX/E variants, BS1H box). DC- prefix only; DMC-S# are small compacts.
LX100 / LX100 II: multi-aspect 4/3 sensor, 10.9mm = 24mm equiv (~2.2x).
L-series premium compacts (DC-L10, 2026): multi-aspect 4/3 sensor, 10.9-34mm = 24-75mm equiv (~2.2x, same as LX100 II).
Micro Four Thirds bodies: G/GH/GF/GX/GM incl. suffixes (M2, MK2, MK3, S, D).
BGH1 box camera, Micro Four Thirds.
Three-digit TZ/ZS (TZ100/110, ZS100/110, TZ200/202/220, ZS200/220, TZ300/ZS300 and D variants): 1-inch sensor.
Four-digit FZ (FZ1000, FZ10002 = FZ1000 II, FZ2000/FZ2500) and Japanese FZH1: 1-inch sensor.
LC1 only: 2/3" sensor. Other DMC-LC models are much smaller sensors (see following rules).
Early CCD travel zooms (ZS1-ZS7 / TZ6-TZ10): 4.1mm = 25mm equiv (~6.1x effective).
TZ5/TZ15/TZ50 (TZ50 = Wi-Fi TZ5, same lens/sensor): 4.7mm = 28mm equiv (~5.96x effective).
Two-digit TZ/ZS travel zooms (ZS8+/TZ18+, ZS99/TZ99): 1/2.3" sensor. Excludes the older CCD TZ1-TZ10/TZ15/TZ50 and ZS1-ZS7 handled by earlier rules.
One- to three-digit FZ bridge superzooms (FZ28-FZ330, FZ80-FZ85/D): 1/2.3" sensor. Excludes FZ1-FZ20 and FZ30/FZ50 handled by earlier rules.
Legacy 2003-2008 compacts with 1/2.5" CCDs (FX1-FX9, FX01/07/10/12/30/33/50/55, LS1-3/LS60-85, LZ1-8, FS2/3/6/7/42/62, F1, LC33-80) per digicamdb/dpreview.
Budget/slim compacts (FS, FH, FX, FP, SZ, XS, S, LZ, LS, F series): 1/2.3"-class sensor. Excludes the 1/1.72" FX100/FX150/FX180; legacy 1/2.5" models are caught by the preceding rule.
